title: Hawkeye Digital taps Securitize for issuer-backed tokenized shares on Ethereum
why_it_matters: This is an issuer-sponsored model for representing actual shares onchain rather than synthetic stock exposure. The proposed transfer-agent reconciliation and preserved voting and dividend rights are significant, but the program remains planned and restricted to eligible holders.
